payload.description: The council prints a personal mobile number for many councillors. Neither this page nor the archive behind it carries one. The numbers are removed from every file when it is downloaded, before anything is saved, so what is stored here reads '[phone number removed]'. That makes this archive not quite a byte-for-byte copy of what the council published, and the same rule takes out the council's own switchboard numbers where they appear on these pages. Anyone who needs a number can find it on the council's own page, which is linked.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
